title: Correct reference documentation and validate Mermaid lifecycle diagrams
description: Correct reference documentation and validate Mermaid lifecycle diagrams
acceptance_criteria: DOCS-4: Reference and contributor documentation accurately describes current commands, settings, defaults, paths, supported platforms and links.
DOCS-5: All maintained diagrams reflect current implementation states, transitions and steps.
DOCS-5.a: CI checks every maintained Mermaid block for parser validity and checks lifecycle states and send-back transitions against source, with failing mutation controls.
DOCS-2 and DOCS-2.a: Reference and generated/copied skill closeout guidance agrees on local verify, review, native archive commit, push and CI.

Protected open-PR lines remain unchanged; HLD F22 follows #935 and Chough session records follow #941. One docs-focused PR carries tests, generated prose and contracts without changing executable lifecycle behavior.

answers.constraints: Generated skill copies must match the installer and digest manifest; specs/agents/agents.3md plane 6 requires advancing the artifact template version and regenerating through the built binary. Archive-first CI and exact-version wrapper boundaries in specs/github/github.3md constrain closeout and version prose. Existing bounds, gates, timeouts, human authority and protected PR hunks remain unchanged.
